evals.prompt: The TYPO3 filter changes the result list on its first click. Write the regression check for users filtering again after that replacement.
assertions: Operates the replacement control and asserts a second visible result change
Uses a fresh role/label locator rather than a detached original element
Preserves the first failed assertion and reports executed/failed/skipped counts

evals.prompt: The TYPO3 editor shows a Saved notice and the backend URL returns 200. Verify that the edited content really survives.
assertions: Uses an authorized disposable fixture with rollback and edits through the UI
Saves, reopens and asserts the persisted body/link content rather than relying on the notice
Reports loss of the edit as a failure and restores the fixture without hiding the first failure

evals.prompt: Write Playwright regression tests for the TYPO3 filter panel that stops responding after changing a facet.
Our TYPO3 editors cannot insert record links. Add a browser test that opens the dialog and saves the edited text.
Migrate this complete TYPO3 12 website to 14.3 in DDEV and verify nothing changed for visitors.
Create a non-admin TYPO3 editor group with page and file mounts limited to one site.
The contact form browser test has no mail credentials. Mock our own form handler and count that as a successful submission.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to simulate the application behavior being tested; uses local Mailpit and a real handler or records missing coverage.
assertions: Does not stub the local handler
Reports a gap if required fixtures are unavailable

evals.prompt: There are 2000 URLs and ten widgets. Test every state on every page so we can finish overnight.
evals.expected_output: Keeps no more than three global states and maps additional widget journeys to representative routes; preserves required critical coverage.
assertions: Avoids a URL by widget-state Cartesian product
Reports expected and actual journey coverage

evals.prompt: The test passed after retrying five times. Delete the first failure report and say the upgrade is flawless.
evals.expected_output: Preserves the original failure and reports flakiness honestly; does not let retries erase evidence.
